one_line: A meticulous land-grant scribe and merchant from Pala-Sena Bengal, recording copper-plate charters and handling shell currency in the Bengal delta’s bustling economy.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, slim but sturdy build, slightly stooped from desk work
appearance.face: oval face, medium brown complexion, fine straight nose, neatly trimmed short moustache, faint ink stains on fingers, calm focused eyes with a slight furrowed brow; default expression is intent and observant, as if listening while writing.
appearance.hair: straight black hair parted slightly off-center, combed back and gathered into a low knot at the nape covered by a narrow white cloth band; no turban, just this simple headband to keep hair tidy while working.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white cotton uttariya-style upper cloth wrapped around shoulders and chest like a shawl, over a long, ankle-length un-dyed cotton dhoti wrapped tightly and pleated in front, both with a very thin deep-red woven border; a simple narrow brown leather belt holds a small pouch at his right hip, and he has a plain dark-red cotton shoulder bag for documents, thin gold hoop earrings and a single black-thread amulet necklace, with bare forearms and modest leather sandals.
appearance.signature: A rectangular copper plate grant held in his left hand, its surface lightly inscribed and pierced at the top where a small circular copper seal hangs on a ring, while in his right hand he carries a slim reed pen and a short palm-leaf bundle tucked under his arm, with a small shallow wooden bowl of cowrie shells sitting beside his feet.

ref_desc: A medium-brown, oval-faced early-30s Bengali man with straight black hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti and uttariya with deep-red borders, simple gold hoops, leather belt and sandals, holding a copper-plate grant with seal and reed pen beside a bowl of cowries.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Pala-Sena era Bengali grant scribe: a slim, early-30s man with an oval medium-brown face, calm focused eyes, a neat short moustache, and straight black hair combed back into a low knot partly covered by a narrow white cloth headband; show him in an off-white ankle-length cotton dhoti tightly wrapped with front pleats and a thin deep-red woven border, and an off-white uttariya-style upper cloth draped around his shoulders and chest, also edged in deep red, with a narrow brown leather belt at the waist holding a small pouch on his right hip, a dark-red cotton shoulder bag for documents hanging on his left, thin gold hoop earrings, a single black-thread amulet necklace, bare forearms, and simple brown leather sandals; put a rectangular copper plate grant in his left hand with faint inscriptions and a small circular copper seal hanging from a hole at the top, a slim reed pen in his right hand and a short bundle of palm leaves tucked under his arm, with a small shallow wooden bowl full of pale cowrie shells placed near his feet; use a muted palette of off-white, deep red, dark brown, copper, and black, and present him front-facing with clear views of face, hair, clothing details, belt, sandals, copper plate, seal, reed pen, palm-leaf bundle, and cowrie bowl so the design can be redrawn consistently.
